d: Galgotias has been in the news lately for all the wrong reasons, and it's not just the AI Summit fiasco you might remember from earlier this year. They allegedly sent 300 buses of students to make up the numbers at Jewar airport's inauguration, and a couple of years ago, there was the embarrassing protest outside Congress headquarters, held by students who couldn't explain what they were protesting. But while you might have heard about these incidents, what you probably haven't heard is the story underneath them. We wanted to understand how one university keeps ending up at the centre of…
